notes.title: DE-EXIT - Eternal Matters Pre-Release Stream
notes.notes:
You are already excited to play DE-EXIT? You can’t wait to experience our cinematic adventure? Well, it’s just one more day until the release of DE-EXIT – Eternal Matters and if the anticipation is too big to handle, we have something special for you: a pre-release stream! 

We will take you through the start of the game, show you some never seen before footage and talk about the game. So, swing by, get a preview of the game and ask any questions you might have. We are looking forward to seeing you on Twitch or YouTube at 19:00 CET.
